title: First sign-in: set up your authenticator
summary: Sign in for the first time, add MERIT to an authenticator app, and save your recovery codes.

steps.say: Use the MERIT address provided by your agency. Your administrator supplies your user name and initial password; there is no public account registration.
onScreen: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · User name * · Password * · Forgot your password? · Continue

steps.say: Enter your user name and password, then choose Continue. Passwords and all security codes are hidden in this training video.
Every account needs a second factor. In Microsoft Authenticator, add an Other account and scan the QR code. Another authenticator app can also scan it.
Cannot scan? Choose Other account and enter the account name and setup key manually. Choose Time based if asked. Keep the setup key private.
onScreen: Account name · MERIT: loginfirst · Setup key (letters and numbers) · Setup key hidden for training

steps.say: Use the current verification code from the MERIT entry in your app. The setup key is not the code to enter here.
onScreen: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · 2. Verify your MERIT account · Enter the current six-digit verification code shown for MERIT in your authenticator app. The setup key above is used only to add the account to your app. · Code from the app * · Turn on and sign in

steps.say: If a code fails, wait for a new one and check automatic date and time on your phone. Keep this page open; starting sign-in again creates a new setup key.
actions: Types into Code from the app (hidden)

steps.say: Enter the current code and choose Turn on and sign in.
actions: Types into Code from the app (hidden)

steps.say: Each recovery code works once if you lose your authenticator. Save them securely now; MERIT will not show them again after you continue.
onScreen: Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training · Recovery code hidden for training

steps.say: Copy codes and Print codes are available. Store your own codes using your agency-approved method; do not share them or put them in a support message.
Continue to MERIT stays disabled until you confirm that the codes are saved. Leaving this page does not skip the requirement.
After saving your codes, select I have saved these codes, then Continue to MERIT. Your account is ready for everyday sign-in.
